lines.text: Hi! This is a sample recording that ships with Reelfold, so you can try a whole batch without your own footage.
Um, the idea is simple.
You record once. You cut it into many short clips. Then you post them on every platform.
In the next two minutes I'll walk through three habits that make this, uh, really easy.
The first habit is
The first habit is to plan the beats before you press record.
Write down three to five points, one sentence each.
And, um, know how you want to end, so every clip has a clear landing.
If a point needs a long explanation, it's probably two points.
The second habit: record it in one take.
Leave a short pause between points. Those pauses become the natural cut lines for your clips.
If you stumble, just, uh, restart the sentence. Don't stop the recording.
The editor keeps the last good take and drops the rest, so a restart costs you nothing.
The third habit is to let the batch do the boring part.
Pauses and filler words get cut, like the ones in this very sample.
Every clip gets captions, a cover and its own copy.
And you export one file per platform, in the right shape, with the right loudness.
So, um, here is what to do now.
Open the review, look only at the clips that were flagged, and fix them by chatting.
When a clip feels right, publish it. That's it. Thanks for trying the sample!
